description: HAL-built Gnat presented to the park 5 Mar 1987 by Air Marshal M L Sethi after refurbishment by 9 BRD Pune (plaque). Poor condition with a sheet-metal canopy; digits 41 on undercarriage doors. Displayed on metal stands in a public park (warbirds.in report by Sumeet Shetty; Bharat Rakshak E-359 lists Kothrud municipal park). Coordinates approximate (park geocode).
